comment: Dead-man switches: each entry asserts an automation left its usual trace recently. mode 'mtime' checks file age; 'date-content' additionally expects the file to contain today's YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/London); graceHourUK suppresses the alert before that local hour. path supports ~. disabled:true = defined but not watched. IMPORTANT: only watch a job whose trace file moves on EVERY run — a job that logs only 'on activity' leaves a frozen mtime on quiet runs and pages a false red (this bit ig-poll and content-poll; ig-poll now writes poll.heartbeat on each clean exit). RE-POINTED 2026-07-27 after the World Cup->Fantasy/PL/Gameday pivot: the WC daily-quiz pipeline (quiz-launch, wc-roll, x-telegram-poll) and several X/content jobs were retired from cron, so their entries were removed; IG came back and Gameday is new, so those are now watched. Verify a trace path is fresh (stat mtime) before adding a job here.

jobs.name: gameday
jobs.note: Gameday pipeline (gate/sync-fixtures/gen-base/gen-recap all append here; runs several times/day). PRE-LAUNCH CRITICAL — PL season opens 2026-08-21.

jobs.name: ig-poll
jobs.note: IG/FB approval poller (every 2 min). Watches the heartbeat touched only on a CLEAN exit, so a crashing poller still goes stale — poll.log stays 0-byte on quiet runs.

jobs.name: ig-send
jobs.note: IG build+send + desk-drop (07:00 daily + desk drops) all append to cron.log.

jobs.name: reddit-track
jobs.note: Reddit watchlist tracker (live growth channel; appends each run).

jobs.name: x-drip
jobs.note: x-queue post --next writes this 4x/day; enable if X posting becomes launch-critical.
